title: Spec 014 Wave 1 readback and pull-request write separation

phases.objective: Keep pull-request validation read-only while preserving the owner/member-controlled issue-comment readback command as the only write-capable evidence entrypoint.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository governance reviewer validating Spec 014 workflow lifecycle boundaries
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A change to the storage control-plane guard, Wave 1 evidence readback workflow, or their executable contract test
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The executable contract proves that pull-request workflows contain no write permission or branch-specific collector, while the exact authorized issue-comment command remains the sole evidence readback trigger.
steps: Load both workflow definitions and the readback script through the executable contract test.
Require the storage control-plane pull-request guard to retain contents: read and its control-plane validation job.
Reject any issues: write, contents: write, pull-requests: write, branch-specific trigger path, or embedded readback collector in the pull-request guard.
Require the Wave 1 readback workflow to accept only the exact governed issue-comment command from an authorized repository association.
Reject any pull_request fallback, hard-coded work-branch name, runtime mutation, SQL, Migration Apply, provider call, credential payload access, or secret inclusion.
assertions: The permanent workflows do not embed a work-branch name.
The readback command remains exact, association-gated, and bound to issue 6215.
The readback script performs no runtime, database, provider, deployment, credential, or external business mutation.
Regression coverage fails if the removed PR fallback or collector job returns.

phases.objective: Publish typed readback-command audit evidence without reintroducing pull-request write authority.
Prove lifecycle separation across reruns, issue-comment retries, and future control-plane guard changes.
This governance-only correction performs no provider or runtime canary.
This correction performs no Production ref update, deployment, restart, SQL, Migration Apply, database mutation, or provider action.
